_about: Rules core (B8060, docs/RULES-CORE.md). notMoved: rules files still in their modules; the list may only shrink, and the move is done when it is empty. stay: rules files of dropped or shelved modules that never move. foundryKnown: files in the rules reach that still name Foundry, to fix; may only shrink. outside: files outside modules/wodx-rules that a package file may import; may only shrink.
